target_by_kind.audio: YouTube 11-character video_id; explicit size/format fallback only
target_by_kind.channel: first 24 hex characters of SHA256(literal source_url without trailing '/')
target_by_kind.playlist: first 24 hex characters of SHA256(literal source_url without trailing '/')

source_url: Exact listing route for channel/playlist; canonical watch URL for video jobs. Never join by display name.

statuses.queued: Prepared or next enumeration page; not evidence a request occurred
statuses.running: Worker lease held; operation may issue zero, one or many HTTP requests
statuses.succeeded: For metadata/captions/media, matching complete artifact required. For channel/playlist, a returned page succeeded; inspect listing_end and tree-completeness flag separately
statuses.partial: Some caption tracks saved, remaining slots unresolved; eligible for bounded resume
statuses.retryable: Interrupted or transient operation; eligible when due and below attempt cap
statuses.disk_wait: Storage cap or reservation unavailable; not necessarily a source failure
statuses.blocked: Actual operation hit access denial or exhausted rate-limit allowance
statuses.unavailable: Actual operation reported unavailable source/track/allowed format
statuses.failed: Actual operation failed validation or another terminal operation error

attempt_status_extra.interrupted: Lease recovered only after owner and child no longer live

attempts_total: Count of leased worker operations, not HTTP requests. The separate ordinary access probe is not a per-item worker attempt.

inventory_units.channel_jobs: Literal channel route jobs, not distinct people or necessarily distinct platform channels
inventory_units.playlist_jobs: Explicit playlist route jobs, kept separate from channels

completeness: complete_returned_public_listing_tree requires listing_end, recursively completed child routes and no unresolved bounded inline containers. Excludes private/deleted/omitted items and original-session verification.

artifact_types.metadata: Complete raw metadata JSON retained outside Git
artifact_types.caption: One offered language/manual-or-auto track retained outside Git
artifact_types.video: Validated real audio plus non-attached video stream
artifact_types.audio: Validated audio fallback, never a video count
artifact_types.quarantine: Unbound or integrity-changed prior media moved aside with provenance/hash audit, complete=false

artifact_identity: job_id + raw_relative_path + exact bytes/SHA256. Actual speaker remains unknown unless independently verified.
raw_bytes: Physical bytes of every non-symlink file in shared external raw tree at export time, including publisher audio, ASR, logs, partials and quarantine. Not a YouTube download count.
byte_units: All *_bytes values are bytes; GiB=2^30 and MiB=2^20 in CLI limits
public_safety: Metadata only. raw_relative_path is local-only and not a hosted download URL. Full signed format URLs, media, captions, process logs and transcripts remain outside Git.
external_access_state: Global access_gate preserves dated probe receipt and its hash; blocked gate does not mark queued items attempted/failed. A successful ordinary probe is prerequisite evidence only, not all-route availability.
